verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail can be driven without its UI through an official MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants read, draft, send and schedule. It also offers trigger-based agents that run proactively. However, every send requires explicit user approval, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec, which limits true unattended or CI automation. Missing for 10: a CLI or public REST API for scripting, documented headless/CI runtime support, unattended send without approval, and independent hands-on corroboration.
